database.name: cursor_test
database.cleanup: AfterAll fixture cleanup completed; disposable container stopped and removed.

scenario.createdAt: All 21 orders share the same timestamp.
scenario.boundary: The lowest-ID order with a ticket is immediately after the first-page cursor, forcing the equal-timestamp id < cursor.id branch.
scenario.foreignCursor: Customer A requests history using Customer B's cursor while A's own order is older.
scenario.assertions: B receives the ticket-bearing boundary order; A receives only A's order and no foreign order ID, ticket ID, or QR token.

scope: Targeted cross-customer cursor/BOLA regression. Comprehensive ASVS/API Top 10 and adversarial BOLA review remain broader open work. Exact-source CI is pending.
